verdict.rationale: Adyen documents general webhooks that push asynchronous status changes instead of polling. The Agentic Cart API has Adyen call the merchant server for session events such as cancel (release reserved inventory) and commit (final price or stock check). Nothing ties these pushes to a subscribable order lifecycle feed. Missing for 10: explicit order-lifecycle event types (created, updated, fulfilled, canceled), any documented subscription mechanism for agents or backends to receive order events, event payload/schema docs, and independent corroboration.
